FLASH CAST provides renovation planning and project coordination for homes and commercial spaces in Kuala Lumpur. We can discuss home renovation, kitchens and bathrooms, custom built-in cabinetry, office fit-outs and shop spaces. The practical scope depends on the property condition, layout and access; a written quotation follows review of the actual work.

To compare renovation contractors in Kuala Lumpur, share the property location and type, approximate size, site photos, intended work and budget range. We review these details and confirm whether a site visit or measurement is needed. Quotations are free. Measurement within 30 km of our company or service point is free; beyond 30 km it is charged, with the fee confirmed before arranging a visit.

For managed properties, working hours, deliveries, access and any landlord, management or authority submissions depend on the specific building and work scope. We can help review the available requirements, while the relevant parties decide approvals. Use the service links on this page to review the matching work, then send your details through the free quotation form.
